confirmedScope.defect: Signed C shifts recorded negative ladder coordinates when source coordinate bit15 was set. Original INC/LSR operations use wrapped 16-bit words and logical shifts.
confirmedScope.fix: Wrap y+4 to uint16_t and logically shift uint16_t x/y before recording tile coordinates.

coverageLimits: Only the named six isolated helper bodies and their listed outputs are compared. Original volatile scratch CPU registers and unrelated RAM are not an equivalence claim.
Prepared synthetic grids cover all sub-tile phases and primary wall masks, selected corner/extended checks, coordinate wraps and flag/control combinations. All possible map grids are not exhaustive.

Ladder/stairs/door-bit coordinate observations are covered. Actual stair traversal, hotel egress, scripted door events, NPC interactions, sprint guards and story sequences need separate native gameplay tests.
No normal-story crash or player-visible scene caused by this particular high-bit coordinate mismatch has been demonstrated.
The oracle emulator executes original routines for development only and is absent from native player releases. No owner ROM bytes or extracted assets are published.
